name: Consecrated Sharpening Stones
label: Quest
description: Consecrated Sharpening Stones: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you bring me eight necrotic runes from the Scourge invaders, I can give you a consecrated sharpening stone. It should be of great help in your battle against the minions of the Lich King.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. Here are your consecrated sharpening stones. Use them prudently.
